name: The Agency: Chapter 2
source:
After experiencing engine problems on board Admiral Ashemont’s flagship “The Orion”, our team of cunning detectives have been forced to land near the affluent town of Pera, a playground for the Empire’s nobility.

While there they are met with an unexpected lead that brings them another step closer to solving the tantalizing mystery behind the Commodore's Uniform.

Take off from where our adventurer’s left off in Chapter One and help them “The Agency” solve the mystery!

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/778760/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
我们的机敏侦探团队乘坐阿什蒙特海军上将的旗舰“猎户座”号时遇到引擎故障，被迫降落在佩拉富裕城镇附近——这里是帝国贵族的游乐场。

在那里，他们获得了意外线索，距离解开“准将制服”背后令人着迷的谜团又近了一步。

从冒险者们在第一章留下的地方继续前进，帮助“调查局”解开谜团！

[来源：[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/778760/]Steam[/url]]
